v1-idle-hook-16x9.mp4: Your down payment is just sitting there, doing nothing. What if it went to work instead? Quasaria AutoPay puts it in an on-chain vault, and the yield goes to your lender as extra principal. Down payments that keep working.
v2-buyer-savings-16x9.mp4: Buying a boat, here's what your down payment could do. An $80,000 boat with 16,000 down. In the vault, that down payment earns simulated yield, about $67 a month at 5%. Swept to your lender as extra principal. It could pay the loan off about 13 months sooner and save around $3,700 in interest. On a $50,000 car, about three months sooner. Illustrative figures, yield varies and can be zero. Quasaria AutoPay, down payments that keep working.
v3-seller-lender-16x9.mp4: For sellers and lenders, every month, the yield on the buyer's down payment arrives as extra principal on the loan. Every deposit, sweep, and payment is on chain, with a payout ledger you can verify. Same lien, same title process. Your financing stays the same. White label it under your own brand, and invite buyers with a link. Quasaria AutoPay. Down payments that keep working.
v4-walkthrough-16x9.mp4: This is Quasaria AutoPay, running on Stellar Testnet. Start on the overview. One tap opens the portal. Connect any testnet wallet. Create a deal. Pick the asset, then set the price and the down payment. Sign, and the down payment moves into the vault, earning simulated yield. Each demo month, the yield sweeps to the lender as extra principal. Pay off early anytime. After the lien is released, the deposit comes back. Quasaria AutoPay. Down payments that keep working.
v5-anything-16x9.mp4: Motorcycle. Car. Boat. Home. RV equipment. Anything with a down payment. Put it to work with Quasaria AutoPay.

v7-precious-metals-16x9.mp4.text: For thousands of years, gold and silver have been a way to store value. Now they're tokenized and on-chain. With Quasaria AutoPay, put your metals to work. Tokenized gold or silver can be your down payment. Pick a metal, enter grams or troy ounces, and see the dollar value live. At deposit, it's converted to USDC for the vault. The yield goes to your lender as extra principal to help pay the loan off sooner. No selling through a dealer. Fast settlement on Stellar. Every step tracked in the open. Metals have historically held value, but prices can move up or down. Illustrative, testnet demo, not investment advice. Quasaria AutoPay, down payments that keep working.

v9-car-dealership-16x9.mp4.text: Van Tora Motors, a busy showroom and lots of deals. A customer picks a car. The dealer sets up the deal in the auto pay seller portal. Car preset, $42,000, $8,400 down, then invite the buyer. The buyer connects a stellar wallet. And the down payment goes into an on-chain USD C vault. Each month the keeper sweeps the vaults yield to the dealer automatically as extra principal. Every installment and every sweep lands in a transparent payout ledger. The app estimates about $35 a month, paid off three months sooner. Illustrative, not guaranteed. Once the loan is paid off and the dealer releases the lien, the plan completes, and the down payment principle goes back to the buyer. Only the yield went to the dealer. Happy customer, deals on track. Quasaria AutoPay, down payments that keep working.

v10-stellar-assets-9x16.mp4.text: Hold assets on Stellar, like XLM. Here's a concept for Quasaria AutoPay. Put them toward your down payment, only verified assets, with issuers confirmed by their home domain to help keep out scam and look-alike tokens. Pick an asset, enter an amount, and see the live USDC value. Prices can move until it's converted. At deposit, Stellar path payments convert it to USDC at the live rate. The vault holds only USDC. Then the keeper sweeps the yield to your lender as extra principal, and you pay each installment. In this example, about $35 a month, paid off three months sooner. Illustrative, not guaranteed. Once the loan is paid off and the lender releases the lien, the plan completes, and your down payment comes back to you in USDC. Only the yield went to the lender. Quasaria AutoPay, down payments that keep working.
